name: Zotero
category: desktop app (reference manager, Firefox-platform JS over mozStorage)
param_style: ? positional via Zotero.DB (mozStorage); SQL concatenated in JS, search conditions compiled to nested IN-subqueries by Zotero.Search._buildQuery
schema_source: resource/schema/userdata.sql (CREATE statements the queries need), resource/schema/system.sql (charsets, syncObjectTypes), resource/schema/triggers.sql (collectionItems triggers), FTS index tables from chrome/content/zotero/xpcom/fulltext.js
data_scale: scale 1: 2 libraries, 12k regular items, 6k attachments, 3k notes, 6k annotations (27k items), ~60k itemData rows over 24k values, 3k creators / 30k itemCreators, 150 collections / 24k memberships, 400 tags, 52k sync-cache rows, FTS5 content + trigram note indexes
visibility_note: 15.8k stars; one of the most widely used reference managers (desktop app on every platform); its SQLite library is the local store for all Zotero sync users
interest_note: The item-tree load computes firstCreator/sortCreator entirely in SQL (COALESCE of CASE blocks over correlated COUNT and ORDER BY/LIMIT-offset subqueries); searches compile to deeply nested itemID IN/NOT IN subqueries with UNION'd trash sets; new FTS5 contentless word and trigram indexes; sync cache MAX(version) GROUP BY and literal UNION-pair joins.
reach_note: millions of researchers; standard reference manager in academia
